title: Nối tri thức và chứng từ làm đầu vào cho Chatbot/Kế toán
statusMeaning: Waiting for prerequisite evidence; no execution has started.
why: Verify upload, retained originals, indexing and evidence retrieval only as supporting capabilities of Chatbot and Accounting. Do not build or release a separate Knowledge Hub.
acceptance: Original upload is verified, owner-bound, digest-bound and retained according to the current recovery promise.
Only entitled nondeleted documents and pinned module knowledge enter retrieval.

Verify actual embedding provider, model, width, collection and billing ownership per layer. The inspected module artifact publisher uses cloudEmbedding; do not label all platform/module knowledge Local from biz.md alone.
Answers expose verifiable citations, conflicts, freshness and uncertainty; missing evidence triggers handoff.
Delete/reindex/retry cannot revive removed or foreign data.
Define second brain provenance separately: Nivo-authored common/specialty packages, owner-approved business documents/configuration, and verified operational records.

The current support-desk and finance-copilot packages each have only two short seed documents. Expand reviewed domain content against the confirmed module promise; do not count seed prose as complete expertise.
Prove retrieval is actually consumed by each relevant runtime path. ModuleOperationAiService.studioTurn currently supplies setup/test draft or applied context and does not itself call retrieval.
Shared knowledge binding is explicit and owner-authorized. Accounting documents, financial facts and chat history are not automatically available to Chatbot.
Balances, payments, receivables and posted entries are read from the authoritative owning API; vector recall is not the source of numerical truth.
Retain origin, version, scope and approval for durable business memory; user corrections update candidates and do not silently promote every conversation into trusted knowledge.

goalDraft.goal: Nối tri thức và chứng từ làm đầu vào cho Chatbot/Kế toán
includes: Nối tri thức và chứng từ làm đầu vào cho Chatbot/Kế toán
Exactly two modules: Chatbot and Accounting; supporting AgentOS flows only.
excludes: Unrelated source, shared credentials and production deployment
Treating a fixture, a mock or an old receipt as a completed live action
Standalone Scheduling, Knowledge Hub, Sales Copilot and broad SMB workbenches

doneWhen.evidence: One bounded source receipt closes the named behavior gap on its session branch.
The required repository gates pass at the delivered head.
Positive and negative API cases read back the resulting state at the served head.
The corresponding real user journey is walked at the delivered head.

goalDraft.sourceRef: user:2026-09-05 final scope: exactly two modules, one accounting and one chatbot; business flows included; Template App later

execution.liveEffects: No live effect is authorized by banking. At activation use environment declarations and the exact mission scope; real outbound messages require explicit user authorization.
execution.seeding: A dedicated owner and stranger, per-flow run namespace, deterministic IDs, exact marker/owner checks on reuse and dependency-safe cleanup. Fixture history is labelled and cannot stand for Test, Apply, payment or provider success. Create fixtures only for the selected Chatbot and Accounting modules; knowledge fixtures are supporting inputs, not a third module.
execution.failureRouting: Read the executing operator stop and current .claude/routing.json; this card defines no alternate routes.
execution.publication: If source is changed, include git.publish only in the activated scope and derive all required gates. Backend business changes also require business.reconcile where a published promise applies.
